name: Echo motif engine
desc: Process-leaning prog lead: a three-note B-minor motif (b-a-f#) fired once a bar into a .55-feedback dotted-eighth delay, while iter walks WHERE in the bar it fires — so motif and echo-train continually re-phase against the groove. One new upper neighbor note per 4-cycle block. Park it for minutes; the delay does the composing.

code.full: note("<[b4 a4 f#4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [b4 a4 f#4 ~ ~ ~ e4 ~] [b4 a4 f#4 ~ d5 ~ ~ ~] [b4 a4 f#4 ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~]>").iter(8).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.004).decay(.12).sustain(0).release(.04).lpf(sine.range(1400, 2600).slow(32)).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.75).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(${fb}).room(.25).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[b4 a4 f#4 ~ d5 ~ e4 ~] [b4 a4 f#4 c#5 ~ d5 ~ ~] [b4 a4 f#4 ~ e5 ~ d5 ~] [b4 a4 f#4 c#5 d5 ~ e5 ~]>").iter(16).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.004).decay(.1).sustain(0).release(.04).lpf(sine.range(1800, 3400).slow(16)).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.3)).delay(.8).delaytime(.28).delayfeedback(${fb}).room(.25).orbit(5).play()
